patterns.description: Customers frequently report issues with the quality of the food, indicating dissatisfaction with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
There are recurring complaints about the pricing being too high or not offering good value for money.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report issues with the quality of the food, indicating dissatisfaction with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation or ingredient sourcing, leading to varying quality of dishes.

root_causes.pattern: There are recurring complaints about the pricing being too high or not offering good value for money.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy is not aligned with customer perception of value, especially when combined with food quality issues.
